name: It Reeks of Rot : Spring
source:
A home, an empty one.
A neighborhood, a peaceful one.
A man, a restless one.
A hand, an adamant one.

[From [url=https://kiv7u.itch.io/it-reeks-of-spring]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一处家宅，空空荡荡。
一片街区，宁静安详。
一名男子，焦躁难安。
一只手掌，执拗不放。

[摘自[url=https://kiv7u.itch.io/it-reeks-of-spring]itch.io[/url]]
